primary_workload: point buffered reads; acknowledged writes secondary after healthy original write baseline
metric: CPU/op reduction >=3% or throughput increase >=3%; full acceptance requires local+real Scylla paired CI and controls
mechanism: Record successful WriteParam offsets and normalized cell state while encoding; slice once-frozen immutable chain directly, eliminating cell prefix reads, ValueReader snapshots and repeated descriptor validation. The offset replaces redundant per-cell type metadata; counter detection reads retained Columns.
memory_budget: No additional retained payload/slab/cell descriptor bytes; temporary ParamWriter gains a 24-byte capture slice (allocator class may add 32 bytes per bind). All capture storage is final EncodedValues.Cells; no pooling or extra lifetimes.
ownership: isolated detached worktree roadmap-04-source; no primary driver changes; no timing while another candidate is being measured
